proposal.summary: Pydio Cells up to 4.1.2 contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) via the 'remote-download' background job which causes the backend to perform an HTTP GET to an attacker-specified URL and save the response to a file.
proposal.cwe_quote: Pydio Cells allows SSRF. For longer running processes, Pydio Cells allows for the creation of jobs, which are run in the background. The job "remote-download" can be used to cause the backend to send a HTTP GET request to a specified URL and save the response to a new file.

AV.quote: The job "remote-download" can be used to cause the backend to send a HTTP GET request to a specified URL

C.quote: save the response to a new file. The response file is then available in a user-specified folder in Pydio Cells.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the SSRF by creating a remote-download job against controlled internal and external URLs to confirm access scope, required authentication, and possible sensitive endpoints; capture request behavior and evaluate whether access control restricts job creation.
